name: gizza-ai/recipe-extract
summary: Fetch a recipe page and extract the clean recipe

tool.description: Fetch a recipe page and return just the recipe: title, ingredients, numbered steps, prep/cook/total time, yield and nutrition — without the blog story, ads or comments. Reads the schema.org/Recipe data the page publishes (JSON-LD, with a microdata fallback). Set format='markdown' (default), 'text' or 'json', and scale=2 to double the ingredient quantities.

format.description: Output shape: "markdown" (default) = headed Markdown with bullet ingredients and numbered steps, "text" = plain text, "json" = the full structured record (title, ingredients, instructions, times, yield, nutrition, image, source).

include_nutrition.description: Include the page's published nutrition facts (calories, protein, fat, …) when it has any (default true). Set false for just the recipe.

max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes of HTML to download (default 4194304, max 8388608). A larger page is rejected rather than truncated, so half a recipe is never returned.

scale.description: Multiply every ingredient quantity by this factor (default 1 = as published; 2 = double, 0.5 = half). Whole numbers, decimals, 1/2, 1 1/2 and unicode fractions are rescaled; quantities the parser can't read ("salt to taste") and the step text are left untouched.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the recipe page to read.
